content: Duw taakw kiradil bayaki kikipaat maaj.
Jisas maa ata waya maaj kitika majir duw takwak wadidiy.
“Kitawa God duw takwak van tinaad. Yitaypika duw nak dikidi nyan taakw kiradil nyaam bayaki kikipaat jabim takadidiy dikik.
“Adi yitaypika duw dikidiy yawiy duw wayaki-didiy nuwukadiy duw takwak akiy wadakikik bayaki kikipatik. Aw day kwasik yidiy yiyak.

“Di nuwukadiy yawiy duw ata maa wayakididiy. Wayakikuw, wadidiy, ‘Gwur yikuw, adiy wun wunadiy watuwadiy duw takwak kitawa dayak aw, Wuna bayaki kikipaat bwutaay kwulapwu-tuwadiy. Wunadiy nimadiy bulmakau awa badiy bulmakau bwutaay viyasipakuw, aw ababa niki kikipaat niki kikipaat bwutaay kwulapwu-tuwadiy. Yaakiya, gwur may wunaki bayaki kikipatik.’

Aw adiy dikidiy yawiy duw yikuw, wadidiy majib wadadiy. Aw day adiy maaj wukiwukik maa wakuw, day dayadiy niki yawiy niki yawiyik yidiy. Duw nak diki mayik yad. Duw nak diki stua ar yad. Aw nuwukadiy duw alib tikuw, adiy yitaypika duw wayakididiy dikidiy yawiy duwaam kaykitikuw, viyaan napakuw, viyasipa-dadiy.
Adi nimadi yitaypika duw a jaav wukikuw, di yaal samasam giraad. Di ata dikidiy vay sawdiy duw wayakidik, yidiy adiy duwaam viyasipakuw, daya tip yiy wapwadakik.

Adi yitaypika duw dikidiy yawiy duwak gaam sikuw, yadaak, wadidiy dayak, ‘Wunaki bayaki kikipaat bwutaay kwulapwu-tuwik rina. Aw adiy yadakikik watuwadiy duw taakw maa wanadiy yayak. Alik wun kwasik yinadiwun day yayak. Aw kita gwur yabir yin yaan tikuw, ababa sitakira-kigwuradiy duw taakw wagwur, yakwadiy wunaki bayaki kikipaat kidakikik.’

Adiy yawiy duw yabir yikuw, samasama duw taakw, nuwukadiy viyakit-adiy, nuwukadiy kupwarap-adiy, sitakirakuw, kwurin karaykuw, adi bayaki kikipaat rinadi wiyaar kawuladaak, adi wiy miyawa wapwurakwud.
Adi yitaypika duw wiyaar wuladik, vagaluwdiy duw takwak vikir, duw nak vidid di kipa wapwiy kwusuwdik.

Adi yitaypika duw dikik ata wadid, ‘Wunadi kapa duw, wun viyakita wapwiy ababa duw takwak kwiytuwadiy bayaki kikipatik. Aw min ata ata kidiy kwusuw-danadiy wapwiy pik kwusuw maarkuw, kidi wiyaar valanadimin?’ Aw adi duw di maaj maa wu. Kip kaygan rad.

Adi yitaypika duw dikidiy yawiy duwak ata wadidiy, ‘Gwur kidi duw dikidiy maan taab yaav jitakakuw, ayakisakw. Kawaar gaan van tina tamiyaam kwakwaad. A tamiyaam di kwataay, nimadib girataay, dikidiy wuk vatikirikiy-kwaad.’”

Jisas dayak ata wadidiy, “Ki maaj liki maaw kitawa wana: God samasama duw takwak akiy wadidiy day dikidi gwalugwur wuladakik. Samasam maa wakuw diki majik, alik day wul maa. Adiy tasakwudidiy duw takwadika day wulakinadiy dikidi gwalugwur.”
Day Jisasaam vasibariyik, “Nyan takis Rom dayadi yitaypika duwak kwiynaak, ay maa?” wakuw, bas sidaad.
Adiy Parasiy day diki maaj wukikuw, day Jisasaam wapakuw, yikuw, maaj ata lakatiydiy, “Ata ata maaj nyan Jisasaam wakuw, vasibariy-kibanaad?”

Maaj lakatiykuw, day ata nuwukadiy dayadiy kalivadadiy duwawa Juw dayadi yitaypika duw, Yirat, dikidiy bapa duwawa wayakidadiy Jisasak. Yikuw, day Jisasak ata wadaad, “Kalivanadi duw, nyan lakwunadiyan min viyakita duw-adimin. Ababa duw taakw rivriv tinadiy minak. Yitaypika duwak niki maaj maa, maaj nak. Min God diki maaj mwiyir kaliva-kwanadimin. Aw min nyanak aw. Nyan wukik, nyan takis Rom dayadi yitaypika duw, Sisaak, kwiynaak, ay maa? Nyana lo atata wana a javik?”

Jisas lakwudil day tikal vitiy tidiy. Alik di dayak ata wadidiy, “Gwur viyuw tikala pik pasira-nadiygwur. Agwa javik gwur gwiyip kwur-gwuradiwun? Takis yapiy-kwagwura saan wunak asimak.” Day saan nak dikik kariyadaal.
Kariyadaak, di dayak bas sididiy, “Kidi kayik mwutamawa si av. Sikanadaad?”
Day ata wadaad, “Sisa dikibir-abir.” Jisas ata wadidiy, “Ay yaakiya, Sisa dikidiy jaav dikik akwiy. Aw God dikidiy jaav dikik akwiy.”
Day a maaj wukikuw, ata pitaan warkuw, day Jisasaam wapakuw, ata yidiy.
Kiyadiy duw taakw rapikidana maaj.
Niki bapa duw, si Satuwsiy, day dayadiy mawulaam wadiy duw kiyakuw, ginyir rap maa. A nyab nuwukadiy Jisasak ata yadiy.

Day Jisasak ata wadaad, “Kalivanadi duw, Mawsis ki maaj sukwudil nyanak, ‘Duw kiyakuw, aw nyan maa, diki taakw kip kwaal, adi duw dikidi mwaam diki taakw kiraan tikida. Li ata nyanugw sapwiy-kiladiy likidi taay duw diki tamiy kwurdakik.
“Tayir abitiy nyamwus mwaam kilim tidiy. Dayadi mwaam taakw kirakuw, ata kiyaad. Aw di nyan maa ti. Kiyadik, dikidi nyamwus diki taakw kiradil maa.
“Atampik dikidi kwukiba nyamwus a taakw kirakuw, dibab kiyaad. Dibab nyan maa ti. Atampik day abab nyamwus, mwamugw likim kirakuw, abab kiyadiy. Nyanugw maa ti.
“Ginyir a taakw ata kiyaal.
“Ginyir God abab kiyanadiy duw taakw kirapitaka-kida nyaam, a taakw sikadi duw taakw tikina? Tayir duw abitiy kiradaal.”
Jisas dayak ata wadidiy, “Gwura maaj viyakit maa. God diki lapa nyigaam rina maaj gwur maa laakw. God diki ap ab gwur maa laakw.
“Ginyir God kiyanadiy duw taakw kirapitakadik, day adawul tipaam kwakinadiy, God diki maaj kardadiy duw kitik. Alik duw taakw kirakir maa.

“Ki kiyanadiy rapa majik gwur God diki lapa nyigaam rina maaj maa vi? God wadidiygwur, ‘Wun Aparam Aysakawa Jakap dayadi God-adiwun tikwanadiwun.’ Aw li God atawa waad adiy Mawsis diki tayir kwakuw kiyadiy duwak gwur lakwu-kigwura adiy duw kiyakuw, kwas maa. Dayadiy mawul kip kwakwanadiy. Alik God di kwakwanadiy duw taakw dayadi God-ad.”
Adiy vagaluwdiy duw taakw wukikuw, day pitaan wardiy diki majik.
Agwa lo ababa nuwukadiy lo-aam kakilna?
Adiy Parasiy day wukikuw Jisas adiy Satuwsiyaam kakildidiy majik, day vagaluwkuw, Jisasak ata yadiy.
Dayaam duw nak, God diki lo kalivadi duwad, di Jisasak bas sidid, “Kalivanadi duw, agwa lo wal ababa lo waam kakilna?”
Jisas dayak ata wadidiy, “‘Gwuradiy maan taab ap bwan mawul miyawa Yitaypika Duw gwuradi Godak yikwadiy.’
Ki lo nuwukadiy lo waam yitaypik tina.
Ki ginyir lo atampik, ‘Gwur gwurak wuki-kwanadiygwur. Atawa walibab tinadiy duw takwak ab awuk.’
Kibir lo Mawsis dikidiy lo wawa God diki maaj wasapwiydiy duw dayadiy kalivadadiy majiwa dayadiy maw-abir.”
Day Jisasak bas sidaad, “God dikidi Tasakwudidi Duw dikidi warag, sikidadaad?”
Adiy Parasiy day Jisasawa vagaluwun tidaak, Jisas ata bas sididiy,
“Gwur wukigwura God dikidi Tasakwudidi Duwak ata ata lakwugwurad? Di sikidi gwalugwa nyan-ad?” Aw day dikik ata wadaad, “Di Davit dikidi gwalugwa nyan-ad.”
Jisas dayak ata bas sididiy, “Agwa javik God dikidi Mawul mwugiydik, nyanadi warag dayadi yitaypika duw Davit sikiydid, ‘Yitaypika Duw-ad’? Aw Davit ki maaj wadil,

content.text: Rikuw, wun minadiy mama nibaam kakilkuw, min dayaam van tikiminadiy.’

content: “Aw li Davit God dikidi Tasakwudidi Duw sikiydid, ‘Wunadi Yitaypika Duwad’ wakuw, ata ata di Davit dikidi waraga nyinda tikik-naad? Alik tikuw, adi duw Davit dikidi yitaypika duw-ad tinaad.”
Aw dayaam duw nak maaj awarab Jisasak maa rav. A nyab kariyarib day Jisasak niki jaav niki jaav bas sisak yagadiy.
